method: Recompute archived evidence; no new model execution, no fabricated labels/signatures.

saved_240_case_semantic_plan_agreement.annotation: Frozen case teacher_plan, Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B stored Teacher plans. Teacher 100% is agreement with its own labels, not independently established human ground truth.
saved_240_case_semantic_plan_agreement.denominators: 240 cases; all Teacher steps, including absent Student steps as mismatches; target_id null==null counts as match.
saved_240_case_semantic_plan_agreement.use_scope: Current v3.1 saved prediction post-hoc diagnostic only. Labels were exposed before adapter revision; not unseen independent B2 validation.

FP32.recomputation_scope: Aggregate arithmetic checked against group counts and saved failure list; raw simulator logs not rerun.

INT8.recomputation_scope: Aggregate arithmetic checked against group counts and saved failure list; raw simulator logs not rerun.

850_case_aggregate_evidence.scope: Cohort inputs/Teacher step counts verified. Student per-case predictions for these 850 cases are absent, so Student agreement ratios are source-reported aggregates, not fresh per-case recomputation.
850_case_aggregate_evidence.speed_warning: Source speed MAE divides finite-value error sum by all numeric Teacher-speed steps including missing Student speeds. Do not interpret this as MAE over matched numeric pairs. Tolerance hit rate treats missing speeds as failures.

shared_asr_frontend.confirmed: Saved ModelRequest.source_text is already text; compressed Student handles downstream plan generation. The archived ASR evaluation covers a separate voice pipeline.
shared_asr_frontend.not_confirmed: No paired current Teacher/FP32/INT8 run manifest binds the identical ASR weights, configuration, source revision and audio input hashes. Shared architecture does not prove current ASR decay = 0.
